description: Plan 166/167 — platform profiles for blending per-leg network grades into global NetworkCondition, plus API-leg latency bands with enter/exit hysteresis. Electron desktop release uses the device profile (not browser).
notes: Weights within a profile should sum to ~1.0 for measured legs; loader renormalizes over legs with weight > 0 that have a sample.
origin weight 0 means exclude package/host assets from the global blend (device/electron: local package or app shell is not a network leg).
browser = Flutter web in a real browser tab only (kIsWeb && !electron shell).
device = native mobile/desktop targets AND Electron-wrapped releases (isElectronShellActive).
Passive runtime scoring is API-only (plan 167 G7); multi-leg weights apply to probe snapshots only.
latency_bands: enter/exit hysteresis for the passive /appdetails API ruler. network_only is used when Server-Timing is present; round_trip when rulerDegraded.

score_to_condition.comment: score >= optimum_min → optimum; below optimum_min → slow (intermittent is flap/error-rate driven, not score)

latency_bands.comment: Provisional P2 values (ms). Re-derive network_only from real networkElapsedMs after Server-Timing is live (plan 167 P3).

device.label: Native app and Electron release
applies_when: OR isElectronShellActive == true (Electron user/admin shells — treat as device, not browser)
